short: Low-Cost Regulating Lithium Deposition Behaviors by Transiti
title: Low-Cost Regulating Lithium Deposition Behaviors by Transition Metal Oxide Coating on Separator

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Li metal anodes suffer dendritic, low-efficiency plating; low-cost ways to regulate Li deposition are needed. A transition-metal-oxide layer on the separator, facing Li, should react with Li to form a passivating interlayer regulating deposition.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/modification), n4 (PRC/deposition), n7 (DES/down_select), n8 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: MnO is cheaper than CoO

states.title: Structure state
states.head: With every TMO/PP separator, Li plates on Cu dendrite-free as a dual layer (sheets over spheres). Contact with Li reduces MnO to metallic Mn0 and Li2O, leaving residual MnO.
states.detail: Absorbed: n5 (STR/microstructure/shape), n9 (STR/phase/identity), n10 (STR/chemistry/composition), n12 (STR/microstructure/shape). Premises: Lattice spacings 0.211 nm = Mn (411) and 0.271 nm = Li2O (111)

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Continuously dissolving MnO self-heals a Mn0/Li2O mixed-conducting SEI that homogenises Li+ flux and suppresses dendrites. MnO coating raises and stabilises Li plating/stripping Coulombic efficiency (~99% at 0.2 mA cm-2) versus bare PP.
states.detail: Absorbed: n14 (MEC/pathway), n15 (PRP/value), n17 (PRP/value). Premises: Li2O-containing SEI is mechanically stronger and more stable than LiF or Li2CO3 SEI; Mixed ionic-electronic conducting SEI homogenises Li+ flux and field and suppresses dendrites

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Li||LFP at 1C with MnO/PP keeps ~132 mAh g-1 and ~100% CE to 600 cycles; PP fails earlier. Sheet-like Li@Cu (2 mAh cm-2) plated with MnO/PP cycles LFP stably ~120 cycles; dendritic Li@Cu fades after ~20

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: A low-cost MnO separator coating builds an in-situ Mn0/Li2O SEI giving dendrite-free Li, stable cycling and practical ultrathin Li anodes

nodes.title: MICRO, F1, F4, F7
nodes.head: All six oxide panels show compact dendrite-free deposits; flat sheets over a sphere layer clearest for MnO and CoO. With plated capacity 0.01 to 0.1 mAh cm-2 dimpled spheres appear and multiply; by 0.5-2.0 flat sheets cover the spheres.
nodes.solves: With every TMO/PP separator, Li plates on Cu dendrite-free as a dual layer (sheets over spheres)
nodes.note: CuO (F1f) shows an equally clear sphere under-layer, so the MnO/CoO ranking is only partly visible; TiO2, FeO, NiO show coalesced sheets with gaps. Sample labels are annotated (PP/TiO2 ... PP/CuO). No particles at 0.01 mAh cm-2; no dendrites in any panel.
nodes.necessity_reason: n5, n12 keeps shown support from o12, o13, o15 after removal.

nodes.title: TEM:HRTEM, F3
nodes.head: HRTEM nanocrystals with fringes d = 0.211 nm (Mn(411)) and d = 0.271 nm (Li2O(111)) in the surface layer
nodes.solves: SEI on the plated Li spheres contains Mn0 and Li2O nanocrystals
nodes.note: Fringes are faint; the FFT inset shows ring spots. Li2O (111) is usually ~0.266 nm.
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown, and n10 keeps shown support from o8, o10, a1.

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: After Li contact the Mn 2p doublet weakens to near noise and its guide lines shift ~1 eV lower. Li 1s peak near 55 eV appears after Li contact; absent for pristine MnO.
nodes.solves: Contact with Li reduces MnO to metallic Mn0 and Li2O, leaving residual MnO
nodes.note: Reduced-MnO trace is at noise level; the shift is carried by the authors' dashed guides more than by resolved peaks. Peak maximum reads ~55.0 eV; text gives 55.6 eV.
nodes.detail: o3: After Li contact the Mn 2p doublet weakens to near noise and its guide lines shift ~1 eV lower; o4: Li 1s peak near 55 eV appears after Li contact; absent for pristine MnO; o5: O 1s main peak moves from ~529.8 to ~531.3 eV after Li contact
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n9 (o4, o5).

nodes.title: EDS:spectrum, F2, F3
nodes.head: Mn EDS signal spreads over the surfaces of both imaged particles. Mn 2p absent at SEI surface; after ~100 nm etching peaks labelled Mn 2p1/2 and Mn 2p3/2 appear.
nodes.solves: SEI on the plated Li spheres contains Mn0 and Li2O nanocrystals
nodes.op: assign features, compare across conditions, cross check consistency, register colocated views
nodes.note: Spacing and intensity ratio in F3h do not match a Mn 2p doublet as seen in F2c; the Mn0 assignment of F3h is doubtful.
nodes.detail: o8: Mn EDS signal spreads over the surfaces of both imaged particles; o10: Mn 2p absent at SEI surface; after ~100 nm etching peaks labelled Mn 2p1/2 and Mn 2p3/2 appear; a1: F3h labelled Mn 2p peaks sit ~639 and ~647 eV (~8 eV apart, 2p1/2 stronger); F2c doublet is ~642/654 eV
nodes.inner_audit: a1: Spacing and intensity ratio in F3h do not match a Mn 2p doublet as seen in F2c; the Mn0 assignment of F3h is doubtful.

nodes.solves: Continuously dissolving MnO self-heals a Mn0/Li2O mixed-conducting SEI that homogenises Li+ flux and suppresses dendrites

nodes.title: ECHEM:CV, F2, F7
nodes.head: CV: MnO/PP gives sharp, symmetric plating/stripping peaks steady over 3 cycles; PP peaks shrink and broaden. CE with MnO/PP/MnO ~99% (0.2/0.2), ~98% (0.2/2.0), ~91% (2.0/2.0) over 100 cycles; PP drops to 40-80% within 50 cycles
nodes.solves: MnO coating raises and stabilises Li plating/stripping Coulombic efficiency (~99% at 0.2 mA cm-2) versus bare PP
nodes.note: Caption says OCV to -0.75 V; plots and linked text show the scan reaching ~-0.15 V. PP at 0.2/0.2 mA cm-2 stays ~95% to ~90 cycles, then falls to ~85%. F7 uses double-sided MnO/PP/MnO, not the single-sided MnO/PP of F1-F6.
nodes.detail: o7: CV: MnO/PP gives sharp, symmetric plating/stripping peaks steady over 3 cycles; PP peaks shrink and broaden; o19: CE with MnO/PP/MnO ~99% (0.2/0.2), ~98% (0.2/2.0), ~91% (2.0/2.0) over 100 cycles; PP drops to 40-80% within 50 cycles
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n15 (o7, o19).

nodes.title: evidence, F7
nodes.head: Symmetric-cell voltage: MnO/PP/MnO steady at about +/-20 mV to ~5100 h; PP grows beyond +/-100 mV and stops ~300 h
nodes.solves: Li|MnO/PP/MnO|Li interface keeps a constant ~20 mV overpotential for 5000 h at 2.0 mA cm-2; PP fails by ~300 h
nodes.detail: o21: Symmetric-cell voltage: MnO/PP/MnO steady at about +/-20 mV to ~5100 h; PP grows beyond +/-100 mV and stops ~300 h

nodes.title: evidence, F8
nodes.head: Li||LFP: MnO/PP + LiNO3 holds ~132 mAh g-1 and ~100% CE to 600 cycles; PP CE collapses at ~120-200 cycles. MnO/PP without LiNO3 fades steadily to ~120 mAh g-1 by 400 cycles, below the PP control (with LiNO3) over cycles ~50-400
nodes.solves: Li||LFP at 1C with MnO/PP keeps ~132 mAh g-1 and ~100% CE to 600 cycles; PP fails earlier
nodes.note: PP capacity stays ~135 mAh g-1 to ~200 cycles before scattering (text: drop after 100 cycles). MnO/PP without LiNO3 CE declines after ~440 cycles. The only PP control contains LiNO3, so the MnO-only benefit is not isolated; MnO/PP alone is not better in capacity than PP+LiNO3 before ~400 cycles.
nodes.detail: o22: Li||LFP: MnO/PP + LiNO3 holds ~132 mAh g-1 and ~100% CE to 600 cycles; PP CE collapses at ~120-200 cycles; a2: MnO/PP without LiNO3 fades steadily to ~120 mAh g-1 by 400 cycles, below the PP control (with LiNO3) over cycles ~50-400
nodes.inner_audit: a2: The only PP control contains LiNO3, so the MnO-only benefit is not isolated; MnO/PP alone is not better in capacity than PP+LiNO3 before ~400 cycles.

nodes.title: evidence, F9
nodes.head: Sheet-like Li@Cu|LE|LFP ~148 mAh g-1 flat to ~120 cycles; GPE flat to 150; dendritic Li@Cu fades from ~20 to ~105 at 45 cycles

nodes.note: Dendritic cell CE falls to ~88% by ~45 cycles; sheet-like cells ~99-100%.
